summary: Private non-profit university in Ankara with 26 undergraduate departments, English-medium teaching and a Diploma minimum of 28 points.
about: International applicants use a separate online form for final-year or graduated high-school students. Eight-semester bachelor's degrees are the catalogue norm; check each department.

ib.text: Diploma: minimum 28/45 and at least one HL subject related to the programme. Predicted grades are not evaluated. No Course Results route is listed.

languageOfInstruction.note: Bilkent states English is the medium of instruction. Departments such as Music and Applied Sciences were not checked for their teaching language.

admissionRoutes.text: Minimum Diploma score 28 of 45 with at least one HL subject related to the programme. Bilkent says minimums do not guarantee admission, and predicted grades will not be evaluated.
The accepted-qualification list names the IB Diploma only; no Course Results route or points is published. Ask Bilkent before relying on certificates.

notes: Apply only if you are in your last school year or have graduated. Pay the USD 30 application fee. Admitted students must bring original copies of every document submitted; Bilkent may verify scores.

Fall 2026 applications ran 2 Feb to 12 Jul 2026 and registration 31 Aug to 1 Sep 2026. Fall 2027 dates are not published. Because predicted grades are not evaluated, a May 2027 IB candidate may need to apply after results; confirm with Bilkent.

English proof: IELTS 6.5 overall with 5.5 per section, or TOEFL iBT 87, valid two years at registration; or take Bilkent's PAE exam on arrival. Students who fall short join the English Language Preparatory Program. No IB English exemption is stated.

Tuition: the only published figure is for 2023-24, USD 16,200 for students admitted in 2023 (including 10% VAT). Current 2027 fees are not published; ask Bilkent. Turkish nationals educated abroad pay the abroad-admission fee.
A scholarships page for international students exists; its terms were not checked.
